retry.Finalize: CDK LambdaInvoke default: Lambda.ClientExecutionTimeoutException, ServiceException, AWSLambdaException, SdkClientException; 6 attempts, 2 s, backoff 2 (a finalizer Err is NOT retried)

decision_order.condition: a path listed by two writers with different sha256
gate report missing or lacking a field
pass, report not pass / gate_fail, report passes

publication.what: the lock holder's owner equals the run's owner, else integrity
the record exists, or is expired past the task TTL; inside the TTL its absence is integrity
an ABORTED trigger cancels a still-working record first
compute terminal, else stop it and return awaiting_compute with the lock held
read the run objects and decide (finalize_run)
settle the record: the arbiter, first writer wins
retention tags on every manifest entry and manifest.json, each read back
release the lock LAST, then re-read it

invariants.text: terminal and classified: after an Ok finalization the task record is terminal and holds a stored result whose phase is completed, gate_failed, failed or cancelled

finalization total and lock released: with no injected fault the first pass returns Ok and releases the single-flight lock, and a later reconcile sweep returns Ok; a held lock is allowed only for compute still billing or one injected transient S3 or backend fault the next pass clears

class decided from the records: when outcome.json parses and names the task, the phase follows the class table whatever the delivery path (refused_other failed with prefilter_disagreement true and the REFUSED line; inputs-changed failed with the flag false; crash and timeout failed with their class text; cpu fallback failed; pass and gate_fail follow the gate report and the pack record); an absent, malformed, foreign or removed outcome is failed with a non-empty error

caller-safe text: the stored payload, verdict.json and manifest.json carry none of the planted hostile constants (an account-id-shaped digit string, an ARN and an ECR host containing it) planted in the Catch Cause, the trainer's refused line, the pack verify and packed lines and an injected S3 error
no .apr unless completed: neither the stored payload's manifest nor manifest.json lists an .apr for any phase but completed
aborted means cancelled: an ABORTED execution yields a cancelled record and a cancelled stored payload

retention tags: every key the finalizer inventories or names (each manifest.json entry, manifest.json, and every self-listing manifest that exists) carries the run's retention tag (keep only for a completed passing run), read back from the bucket
delivery-path independence: for the same records, every non-aborted trigger that returned Ok reaches the same phase, is_error, prefilter_disagreement and keep

rows.what: Train succeeds (SageMaker job Completed; run_step exit 0 for pass and gate_fail) -> PackVerify
PackVerify succeeds (pack exit 0: skipped, accepted or refused recorded) -> Finalize, payload without error

Train fails (job exit 1: refused, crash, timeout, cpu fallback, or any upload failure) -> Catch States.ALL -> CatchFinalize, resultPath $.error: the finalizer gets a stage error for EVERY catch-fed class
PackVerify fails (PackError exit 1 with no pack-outcome.json, env/contracts refusal exit 2, an upload failure exit 1, the 3 h task timeout) -> Catch States.ALL -> CatchFinalize, resultPath $.error

Finalize has no Catch (only the CDK Lambda service-exception Retry, 6 attempts): a finalizer Err ends the execution FAILED, which falls to the status rule and the 10-minute reconcile (both deliver stage_error None)
CatchFinalize has no Catch (same Retry): its Err ends the execution FAILED; the status event and the reconcile then re-drive it WITHOUT the stage error
machine TimeoutSeconds 36000 (MACHINE_TIMEOUT_SECS) -> TIMED_OUT -> status rule (and reconcile)
a client cancel -> StopExecution (cancel sink) -> ABORTED -> status rule; the finalizer cancels the record and finalizes cancelled
a lost status-rule delivery (best effort, retryAttempts 4, DLQ) -> the 10-minute reconcile sweep is the floor
StartExecution rejected or ambiguous at dispatch (request side): rejected compensates and releases; ambiguous + unconfirmed leaves the lock for the reconcile's dispatch-unconfirmed path
pass -> train job exit 0 -> Finalize path
gate_fail -> train job exit 0 (the pack stage runs on a gate_fail)
refused -> train job exit 1 -> CatchFinalize only
crash -> train job exit 1 -> CatchFinalize only
timeout -> train job exit 1 -> CatchFinalize only
a failed upload forces exit 1 for ANY class (Run.finish: code = 1 if failed and code == 0), so pass and gate_fail can arrive through the Catch too, with outcome.json possibly listed but absent
a CPU fallback is classified crash with device_ok false (finish_after_trainer), so it is catch-fed
decide_skip: a non-pass/gate_fail outcome, device_ok false, or a gate_fail without a waiver claim -> pack-outcome skipped, exit 0 when published
pack and verify accept -> .apr uploaded, accepted pack-outcome, exit 0
pack or verify refuse (rc 3) -> accepted false recorded, exit 0 (PackVerify succeeds)
PackError (outcome, manifest, download, integrity, base, child) -> exit 1 with NO pack-outcome.json -> PackVerify Catch: stage error plus a missing pack record
entry_pack env or contracts refusal -> exit 2 before any download, no pack-outcome.json -> PackVerify Catch
publish_pack lists pack-outcome.json in pack-manifest.json BEFORE uploading it; a failed last upload leaves it listed but absent (exit 1)
outcome.json absent -> read as missing -> failed 'outcome.json is missing' (or the stage error)
outcome.json malformed or over the 1 MiB cap -> warn log, read as missing
outcome.json names another task -> warn log, read as missing
run/gate-report.json absent, malformed or oversize -> missing (it carries no task id, so no foreign check)
pack-outcome.json absent, malformed, oversize or foreign -> missing
training-manifest.json absent or foreign -> partial-manifest.json is read; both absent -> no training entries
pack-manifest.json absent or malformed -> empty (no task-id check: it is a bare array)
any read failing for another reason (5xx, denied, a broken body) -> Store error, nothing settled or the publish resumes; the lock is held and the next pass heals
a manifest entry listed but absent in S3 (FS-EX-06, FS-PK-06): read_run_objects keeps the entry
aborted -> cancelled, entries minus the .apr
a path listed by two writers with different content -> failed integrity
stage_error Some -> failed with the stage text, returned BEFORE outcome.json is read
no outcome -> failed 'outcome.json is missing'
refused inputs-changed -> failed, prefilter_disagreement false
any other refusal -> failed, prefilter_disagreement TRUE, the REFUSED line (D-08); reachable only with stage_error None
crash -> failed 'the trainer crashed'
timeout -> failed 'runtime cap'
device_ok false (pass or gate_fail) -> failed
gate-report.json missing, or lacking a required field -> failed
outcome and gate report disagree on pass -> failed integrity
rows.note: untested at HEAD: no test builds an outcome that contradicts its gate report, and the sweep's gate report is always consistent with the outcome

rows.what: pass -> decide_packed: pack record missing or refused -> failed (D-15); waiver mismatch or apr sha not listed -> integrity; accepted -> completed, keep
gate_fail without a waiver claim -> gate_failed (non-error, no pack); with a claim -> decide_packed waived
compute gate: a training job or pack task still billing -> stop it, awaiting_compute, nothing written, lock held
the record settles first (first writer wins; Cancelled gets the aborted payload attached; terminal-without-result is integrity)
verdict.json = the winning payload's text, written only when different
manifest.json: adopted when it already lists this verdict, else written from the decision's entries plus the unlisted count
tag targets = every manifest.json entry plus manifest.json: a listed-but-absent key fails GetObjectTagging (NoSuchKey) and wedges the lock
the self-listing inventories (training-, partial-, pack-manifest.json) are never tag targets: a kept run's inventories keep 'expire'
every tag read back; the lock released LAST and re-read; a failure at any step returns Err with the lock held
record missing past the task TTL -> an existing verdict.json is the decision, else the fresh one; inside the TTL -> integrity, nothing written

finalizer.rs bounded_error forwards the Catch `Error: Cause` (a DescribeTrainingJob JSON naming the ECR image and role ARN) as stage_error -> finalize.rs payload.error -> the stored payload, verdict.json, train_status
lib.rs submit: the mint, lock-backend and envelope error texts reach pmcp Error::internal and the compensated payload

rows.what: job-written lines reach the caller verbatim: outcome.refused_line in the error, pack verify_line / packed_line in verdict.pack.line and the pack-refused error
finalizer-side renderers (objects.rs S3, compute.rs SageMaker / ECS / Step Functions) -> FinalizerError -> the Lambda error and the execution history only, never a stored payload
dataset.rs renderers -> tracing::warn only; the refusal names the bucket and prefix, never the SDK text
sfn.rs describe (dispatch confirm) and stop (cancel sink) renderers -> eprintln / tracing::error only
log calls (tracing, eprintln, println) in the two crates: server-side log only
static caller texts (validation refusals, single-flight, failed_payload reasons with no infrastructure text, orphan dispatch-unconfirmed, stage_error None)
the run bucket is named aprender-laya-train-<env>-<account> (laya-trainer-stack.ts), so StatusPayload.run_prefix, every manifest link and the dataset refusals carry the account id BY CONSTRUCTION
